subject: [RFC PATCH 1/3] iommu/iova: convert from rbtree to maple tree

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch converts the iommu/iova code from using a red-black tree to a maple tree data structure, which improves performance by reducing the time complexity of finding free space from O(n) to O(log n). The change also simplifies the code and reduces memory usage. The maple tree is used to index iova ranges, allowing for efficient gap searching and allocation. Additionally, the patch removes unnecessary fields and locks, and updates related data structures to work with the new tree implementation.
